profile_text.body:
Gong is a for-profit startup founded in 2015 and headquartered in Palo Alto, CA. The company describes itself as a provider of a "Revenue AI OS," a platform it positions as serving go-to-market organizations through what it calls multimodal revenue signal processing, specialized AI agents, and purpose-built applications. Its stated use cases include closing deals faster, predicting pipeline risk, automating handoffs, and reducing customer churn.

The company's core product, tracked under the Notes, Knowledge, and Meetings category, is Gong itself, which centers on revenue intelligence, call analysis, and deal coaching. Named sub-products include Gong Engage, described as a sales engagement tool that uses AI to prioritize and personalize communications, and Gong Enable, which includes an AI Trainer feature the company says allows sales teams to build training from recorded customer conversations. A customer quoted on the site states that Gong saved their organization 6,700 hours across call prep, follow-up, and CRM updates, and that a Gong AI Tracker agent helped lift buyer response rates by 32%.

The held facts note that Gong's product profile flags sensitive sales data exposure as a point of relevance, which reflects the nature of the call recording and conversation analysis it performs. No litigation or SEC filings are recorded for the company. Three MCP server entries appear in the registry under names referencing SQLite database tools, though these appear to be third-party or community-built tools associated with the Gong name rather than official Gong products.
